_source: 01 L98-114 (the table), 01 L116-135 (rl status ten sections and --json keys)
_note: gyb is not a role class; rl status sections and list filters are derived from this table, not from the five role tables (00 L25; 01 L100).

usecases.wants: where each line stands, who is working, what waits for me
usecases.derived: rl status [--line L] [--group-by line|batch]; every row carries the line name and decision id; --json row structure is fixed

usecases.wants: evaluations waiting for approval, feedback waiting for a verdict
usecases.derived: status sections 3 and 8; eval approve ID... --quote; feedback accept

usecases.wants: issues assigned to me and still open (those idle beyond issues.gyb_stale_hours marked)
usecases.derived: status section 2; issue reply; issue close

usecases.wants: orders waiting for acceptance (including quick-lane supplements), report paths
todo orders whose owner has no live session, orders gyb takes manually
usecases.derived: status section 5; each row carries the 'load which role' command

usecases.wants: where running experiments are, log and watch commands
usecases.derived: status section 1 launch-order rows carry log_path and watch_cmd; grouped per batch

usecases.wants: run to launch order to work order to decision
live orders citing an old version and their holders, stale orders, live orders under retired decisions
usecases.derived: status section 6; decision update/retire print on the spot; handoff withdraw/reissue

usecases.wants: sessions and orders idle for long, stuck ones, quick lanes not closed
usecases.derived: status sections 7 and 9 plus rl reclaim without --apply as preview; reclaim output grouped by owner with ready-made commands

usecases.wants: what doctor found and nobody fixed
usecases.derived: status section 10; rl doctor with a fix and 'who pushes after the fix' per item

usecases.wants: who that holder session is, alive or not

status_sections.text: orders not in a terminal state (owner, holder and whether alive, status, age, line; launch orders with log_path and watch_cmd)

open issues assigned to gyb (those beyond issues.gyb_stale_hours marked); this section is the only outlet for an issue assigned to gyb, opened or reassigned: no desktop notification (01 L139; sync-inbox Q40(c)(d) L286-287)
waiting for gyb to start: todo orders whose owner has no live session, dispatch=manual orders
stale orders and live orders under retired decisions
in_progress orders whose holder session has not written for more than status.stale_holder_minutes
recent review/ checklists, live sessions (with focus), quick lanes not closed (not assigned to a line; listed as a separate heap under --group-by line)
what the last doctor run found and nobody fixed

status_first_line: days since the last reclaim (01 L120; 01 L147)
